annotations.title: Get the labels of the Global FinReg views

description: For the Global FinReg views only, not for the assistant: returns the views' labels in a language and what the views may offer on this endpoint. It returns no data about the user.

language.description: The language as a BCP 47 tag, e.g. da or pt-BR. Default: the language of the user's account, or English.

name: get_ui_labels
